design_brief.problem_statement: Canonical main has server-predicted multiplayer foundations and accepted legacy evidence that owner-authoritative realtime locomotion removes local movement stutter, but the accepted M7 evidence lives on a heavily diverged FIX lineage and cannot be merged as production architecture. H0.2 must prove a minimal current-main implementation and the Harness HIGH-risk path without importing duplicate authority layers.
design_brief.current_behavior: Canonical R3 generation 79 main is 09714b6f2681e3b5cf3f2f9e28416cf9a7378304. Project Control now installs its canonical pinned Harness dependency before contract validation. Current networked gameplay remains server/domain authoritative and includes the existing M3/NX6 runtime, while the fresh H0.2 R3 branch contains only reviewed control records at dispatch time. Legacy M7 owner-authority runtime 464e1b8dd27fad8b4d477f6e76ca52a449893353 and acceptance record 538674d1f3f991c9e04d77b0ce0a4dfea24d9ce6 are evidence only, not merge bases or cherry-pick authorization.
design_brief.desired_behavior: Provide a selectable OWNER_AUTHORITATIVE_VALIDATED realtime locomotion authorship profile in which the local deterministic physics controller is the sole local body writer, the server validates owner/session/epoch/playable state and bounded movement before updating the canonical player record, remote players continue through snapshots/interpolation, ordinary accepted snapshots do not rewind the local owner, and same-revision item rejection rolls back presentation without moving Item Graph authority to the client.
alternatives_considered: Merge or cherry-pick the historical M7 FIX6/FIX7/FIX8/FIX9/FIX10 lineage
Keep server-predicted locomotion only and accept the known local presentation symptom
Reimplement only the proven capability units on exact current R3 main behind a bounded authority profile with explicit validation and rollback contracts
design_brief.selected_design: Reimplement the minimal capability units on the fresh R3 Work Order branch: a small MovementAuthorityProfile, owner movement server validation/service composition, owner-specific graphical/dedicated runtime composition, reuse of current remote snapshot interpolation, and same-revision optimistic item-presentation rollback. Do not import legacy render-body writes, the FIX ladder, Character UI overlays, protocol-manifest changes or new canonical authority foundations.
design_brief.why_selected: It preserves current canonical ownership and persistence truth, directly targets the accepted owner-authority capability, minimizes blast radius, keeps the change in HIGH rather than silently escalating to CRITICAL, and makes every risky boundary independently testable under the H0.2 checkpoint.
